name: daily-kb-sync
prompt: Mirror the designated Notion 'Company KB' database into business/knowledge-base/product-spec.md. Each page becomes a markdown section. Preserve the page hierarchy. Also mirror the 'Pricing' page into business/knowledge-base/pricing.md and the 'ICP' page into business/knowledge-base/icp.md. Overwrite the local files entirely (don't merge — Notion is source of truth). Do not post to Slack unless the sync fails — in that case post the failure to #product.
